raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Starting with batches 13-14, the source began sending separate status='REVERSAL' rows that point back to the original transaction through orig_txn_id. The fix assumes each reversal cancels its whole original, matching the old REVERSED behaviour; the amounts were not visible to confirm there are no partial reversals.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions v WHERE v.status = 'REVERSAL' AND v.orig_txn_id = r.txn_id)"}}
